purpose: Define every managed human-facing UI label as an explicit identity with context metadata, separate from internal command/resource identifiers.

topics.name: UI Label Identity
topics.purpose: Define every managed human-facing UI label as an explicit identity with context metadata, separate from internal command/resource identifiers.

semantics.identity_rule: Each managed label has an explicit stable label identity.
semantics.source_rule: Canonical source language/value is explicit by localization profile.
semantics.internal_rule: Internal commands/identifiers remain English/ASCII and are not replaced by localized labels.
semantics.reuse_rule: Same visible text may correspond to multiple label identities in different contexts.
semantics.authority_rule: Label text never defines resource authority.

invariants.rule: UI visibility, navigation, placement, styling, selection, focus and visual adjacency never create semantic ownership, resource identity or execution authority.
Effect-capable UI actions create explicit candidate/request data and must cross canonical validation, authorization and dispatcher boundaries before effects occur.

hard_gates.condition: display text used as command id
same word merged across contexts automatically
translated label changes internal resource id
special characters introduced into command identifiers
